summary: Comprehensive testing of multi-currency feature. All currency flows verified: platform default currency (GBP), tenant-specific currency (USD for techstore), currency selection UI for both SaaS admin and tenant admin, Stripe checkout currency handling. Fixed one bug in analytics page where currency variable was undefined.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency feature fully tested. Platform default is GBP, techstore tenant uses USD. All currency selection UIs working. Stripe checkout uses correct currency (platform for subscriptions, tenant for shop).

bugs_fixed.issue: Error: currency is not defined at line 106
bugs_fixed.fix: Added resolvePlatformCurrency() call to get currency variable before rendering
bugs_fixed.root_cause: The page imported resolvePlatformCurrency but never called it, leaving currency undefined

notes: Platform default currency: GBP (stored in __platform_settings__ JSON)
Tenant currency: USD for techstore (stored in store_settings.currency)
Subscription billing always uses platform currency (GBP)
Shop checkout uses tenant currency (USD for techstore)
All 31 currencies in SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES are valid Intl.NumberFormat codes
